description: This file defines the 'Leave' entity class for the OrangeHRM HRM system. It models leave records with properties such as id, date, hours, days, status, leave type, employee, start/end times, and duration type, along with ORM mappings and related methods.

classes.name: Leave
classes.description: Represents a leave record with properties for leave details and ORM mappings, including constants for statuses and duration types, and traits for additional functionalities.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the leave record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the leave record.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the leave.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the leave.

methods.name: getLengthHours
methods.description: Returns the number of hours of the leave.

methods.name: setLengthHours
methods.description: Sets the number of hours for the leave, formatted to 2 decimal places.

methods.name: getLengthDays
methods.description: Returns the number of days of the leave.

methods.name: setLengthDays
methods.description: Sets the number of days for the leave, formatted to 4 decimal places.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status code of the leave.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status code of the leave.

methods.name: getLeaveRequest
methods.description: Returns the associated LeaveRequest object.

methods.name: setLeaveRequest
methods.description: Associates a LeaveRequest with this leave.

methods.name: getLeaveType
methods.description: Returns the LeaveType associated with this leave.

methods.name: setLeaveType
methods.description: Sets the LeaveType for this leave.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee who took the leave.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with this leave.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time of the leave.

methods.name: setStartTime
methods.description: Sets the start time of the leave.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the end time of the leave.

methods.name: setEndTime
methods.description: Sets the end time of the leave.

methods.name: getDurationType
methods.description: Returns the duration type of the leave (full day, half day, etc.).

methods.name: setDurationType
methods.description: Sets the duration type of the leave.
